coordinate_sensitivity_note: Median of per-coordinate medians; coordinates are a coarse cluster proxy, not verified buildings.
area_missing_policy: Retained for monthly-rent analysis; omitted only from rent-per-area analysis.
outlier_policy: Bedroom-specific 1.5 IQR flags for n>=4; no automated removal or winsorization.
observation_unit: One provider listing ID. Room-vs-entire-unit and floorplan-vs-specific-unit semantics are not independently verified.
